verdict.rationale: First-party docs show an agent can check availability via the API (calendar and event-type availability data) and book meetings end to end through the Scheduling API. An official MCP server with Dynamic Client Registration translates natural-language commands into API calls. However, the evidence never shows an API or MCP action to reschedule or cancel: webhooks only notify you of cancel and reschedule events, and the reschedule request is a dashboard Workflows feature. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoints for rescheduling and cancelling, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent booking working end to end.
